question: On non-near-square balanced semiprimes, does the Gap Winner Rule (GWR) selected carrier_w land closer to the true factors {p,q} than a uniform random control drawn from the same public certificate search band?

primary_metric.name: median_delta_distance
primary_metric.definition: median over cases of (median(D_u) - D_c), where D_c is factor-distance of carrier and D_u is factor-distance of control sample

search_band.definition: Closed interval [lower_anchor, upper_anchor] of the lower certificate chamber

statistics.decision_rule: Reject H0 if p < 0.05 and median_delta_distance > 0

reporting_allowed_after_run: measured on hold-out corpus C with N cases
